name: Will removing kitchen cabinets damage the drywall behind them?

mainEntity.name: Will removing kitchen cabinets damage the drywall behind them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some wall damage is common, ranging from minor fastener holes to torn paper or drywall gouges where adhesives or backsplashes were pulled away. Because HH Remodeling handles both tear-out and interior finishes, our team inspects the exposed framing immediately after removal. We repair damaged drywall, tape, and skim coat surfaces to prepare the space for new cabinetry, fresh paint, or tile. This integrated approach prevents homeowners from having to hire separate drywall contractors after tear-out.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor drywall damage and screw holes are common, especially around glued areas, but these surfaces can be patched and prepped before new cabinets go in.
